description: Validation defect D1 (independent computational validation, 19 Nov 2026): the header plate was drawn as seen from outside and the branch as seen from inside (the mirror image of Spec 02 section 4.4), and no marking side was stated. Marked on the same face, the branch of an offset, oblique joint misfits by up to tens of millimetres (27 mm for the first case). The interface check could not see it because each part was folded back with the convention it was built with. Fixed in uem develop::branch_stub (pattern (r*phi, s), outside view), with a declared marking side on every pattern and verifier checks that fold back by the DECLARED side: saddle_handedness_matches_declared_side, parts_declare_the_same_marking_side. All cases are chiral (delta != 0 and beta != 90 deg) and must verify.
fixed_in: uem develop::branch_stub; verify::fold_branch / fold_header; nf-core gate G02 (marking side)
